resume.metaDescription: 6+ years in backend and architecture for Web3 trading, OTC, fiat on/off-ramp, and Card fund rails.

summary.body: 6+ years in backend and architecture, focused on Web3 trading. Led core fund rails including OTC, fiat on/off-ramp, and Card, and built third-party channel services in Go. Strong in Go, Java, Node.js / PHP (Swoole/Hyperf) and microservices; fluent with MySQL, Redis, Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker/K8s. Led PHP-FPM to resident in-memory migration: QPS up 300%+, core API latency down 60%, availability 99.9%.

business.title: Core business & architecture
bullets: Owned backend architecture, APIs, and ongoing optimization for OTC, fiat on/off-ramp, and Card fund/trading rails.
Built third-party channel services in Go (Gin / GORM): payment and on/off-ramp integrations, callback signature verification, reconciliation, and retry on failure.
Split service boundaries and call chains as microservices; delivered across Go / Node.js / PHP, Nginx, Docker / K8s, and multiple environments.

stability.title: Concurrency & stability
bullets: Led a smooth migration of the core PHP system from FPM to Swoole / Hyperf resident in-memory architecture; QPS up 300%+.
Built memory-leak monitoring and diagnosis; availability 99.9%. Slow-query work cut core API latency by 60%.
Tuned MySQL, Redis, and message queues for trading / on-off-ramp consistency; established rollback and health-check release flow.
PHP backend on the controller side and core modules of the AI business-perception system; APIs, integration, and microservice collaboration (CodeIgniter, SQLite).
Backend data processing and ingest validation for production systems; WeCom apps and staff-sync scripts; won the 2021 GM Award.
Mall backend and campaign modules with ThinkPHP and MySQL; data collection and processing for Tmall One-Hour Delivery.
